summary: Route file-watch events and coverage changes only to intersecting input leases

schema.detail: The performance endpoint adds cumulative file_watch_work counters for events, event and coverage deliveries, and scoped versus global notifications.

rules.detail: Root-indexed routing applies lexical and referent input relevance before borrowing an event to selected callbacks. Coverage replacement and directory-loss generations are scoped to intersecting roots. File-gate changes enqueue only their dependent mission runs; launch-admission or other global readers and genuine lost-path rescans retain the common-loop notification.

compatibility.detail: Any matching path, ancestor renames and removals, symlink referents, and backend-error rescans remain observable. Unrelated sibling activity and read events do not notify reconciliation.

recovery.detail: True rescan and error events retain all-root recovery. Maintenance invalidations reread only leases intersecting replaced coverage.
